summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the project's data schema definitions. Its primary architectural purpose is to ensure the integrity, validation logic, and structural correctness of the defined data schemas through automated verification processes.
responsibilities: Execute automated tests against defined schemas
relationships: Tests validate the structural rules defined within the project schemas.
The test suite ensures that schema validation logic behaves correctly under various data scenarios.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with their respective schemas
Use of unit testing for individual schema definitions
